# Fern

## Detect

- `fern/docs.yml` next to `fern/fern.config.json` (also nested, for example `docs/fern/`). `fern.config.json` without `docs.yml` is an SDK-only project; the docs live elsewhere.
- API definitions in the same folder: `generators.yml` with `api.specs` (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI), `fern/apis/<name>/` for several APIs, or a Fern Definition (`api.yml` plus YAML service and type files).
- A stale `docs.yml` can outlive a move off Fern. Confirm the live site: `curl -sI https://<docs-domain>/ | grep -i x-fern`.
- Only the docs move. Do not delete or edit `generators.yml`, the definition or `fern.config.json`; SDK generation uses them.

## Get the source

Mintlify's guide for this platform: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/migration/fern.md

### From the repo

- Read `docs.yml`, then every file it references (product and version YAML, redirect files, `css`, `js`). Paths in a Fern YAML file are relative to that file.
- Pages: `.md`/`.mdx` files referenced by a `path` or found by a `folder` entry. Unreferenced files are not published.
- Snippets live in a `snippets/` folder; changelog entries in a `changelog/` folder (reserved name).

### From an export

Not covered yet. Use the repo.

### From the live site

Clean Markdown at `<page-url>.md`; page list at `/llms.txt`.

Reference: https://buildwithfern.com/learn/docs/getting-started/project-structure

## Navigation

`docs.yml` `navigation` is the sidebar; folders on disk do not define it. References: https://buildwithfern.com/learn/docs/configuration/navigation, `/tabs`, `/versions`, `/products` under the same path.

- `tabs:` (key → `display-name`, `icon`, `slug`, `skip-slug`, `href`, `changelog`) with `navigation: - tab: <key>` + `layout:` → tabs; an `href` tab → tab `href`. Tab `variants`: keep the default; report.
- `section` + `contents` → group; nested sections → nested groups; section `path` → `root`; `collapsed: true` → `expanded: false`; `collapsed: open-by-default` → `expanded: true`.
- `page: Label` + `path` → page; `Label` (or frontmatter `sidebar-title`) → `sidebarTitle` when it differs from `title`.
- `folder: ./dir` (+ `title`) → group of that folder's files: `index` → `root`; frontmatter `position` (numeric) first, then alphabetical; subfolders → nested groups.
- `link` + `href` → `navigation.global.anchors`.
- `api: Name` (+ `api-name`) → a group with that API's spec.
- `changelog: ./changelog` → the changelog page at that position.
- `hidden: true` → hidden page or group.
- `availability` (`beta`, `pre-release`, `in-development`, `deprecated`) → `tag`, or `deprecated`.
- `products:` (`display-name`, `path`, `icon`, `subtitle`, `href`) → `navigation.products` (`subtitle` → `description`).
- `versions:` (`display-name`, `path`, `availability`) → `navigation.versions`; the first is the default.

## Content conversion

Fern and Mintlify component names overlap but props differ. Reference: https://buildwithfern.com/learn/docs/writing-content/components/overview

| Fern                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Mintlify                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<Note>`, `<Tip>`, `<Info>`, `<Warning>`, `<Check>`                                                                                                                                                                | same                                                                                              |
| `<Success>` / `<Error>` / `<Launch>` / `<Callout intent>`                                                                                                                                                          | `<Check>` / `<Danger>` / `<Info>` / the matching callout                                          |
| `<TabGroup>`, `<Tab language>`                                                                                                                                                                                     | `<Tabs>`, `<Tab>`                                                                                 |
| `<CodeBlocks>`                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `<CodeGroup>`                                                                                     |
| `<CodeBlock title>` around a fence                                                                                                                                                                                 | the fence with that title                                                                         |
| fence `filename=`, `wordWrap`, `{1,3-4}`                                                                                                                                                                           | fence title, `wrap`, `highlight={1,3-4}`                                                          |
| `<Code src>`                                                                                                                                                                                                       | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports)                                                 |
| `<CardGroup>` / `<Card>`                                                                                                                                                                                           | `<Columns>` / `<Card>`                                                                            |
| `<ParamField path="name">` (Fern's `path` is the field name)                                                                                                                                                       | `<ParamField>` with `query`, `body`, `header` or `path` by context                                |
| `<Files>` / `<Folder>` / `<File>`                                                                                                                                                                                  | `<Tree>` / `<Tree.Folder>` / `<Tree.File>`                                                        |
| `<Badge intent>`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `<Badge color>`                                                                                   |
| `<Aside>`                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `<Panel>`                                                                                         |
| `<Indent>`                                                                                                                                                                                                         | unwrap; nested fields → `<Expandable>`                                                            |
| `<Button href>`, `<Download src>`                                                                                                                                                                                  | a link or `<Card>`, a link to the file                                                            |
| `<Versions>` / `<Version title>`                                                                                                                                                                                   | `<Tabs>` / `<Tab>`                                                                                |
| `<If products versions roles>`                                                                                                                                                                                     | the content for this page's product or version; report role-gated text                            |
| `<EndpointRequestSnippet>`, `<EndpointResponseSnippet>`, `<EndpointSchemaSnippet>`, `<WebhookPayloadSnippet>`, `<Schema>`, `<RunnableEndpoint>`                                                                    | link to the endpoint page, or `<RequestExample>` / `<ResponseExample>` with static fences; report |
| `<Markdown src="/snippets/x.mdx" k="v" />`; `{{k}}` inside the snippet                                                                                                                                             | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content); `{{k}}` → `{k}`                            |
| custom React components                                                                                                                                                                                            | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                                             |
| `## Title [#slug]`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs)                                                  |
| changelog files named `YYYY-MM-DD`, `MM-DD-YYYY` or `MM-DD-YY`; `overview.mdx`; frontmatter `tags`; `<ChangelogTags>`                                                                                              | see `mint migrate --topic changelog`; the file name is the date; drop `<ChangelogTags>`           |
| frontmatter `sidebar-title`, `subtitle`                                                                                                                                                                            | `sidebarTitle`, `description` (if none)                                                           |
| frontmatter `layout: reference` / `page` / `custom`                                                                                                                                                                | `mode: "wide"` / `"center"` / `"custom"`                                                          |
| frontmatter `hide-nav-links` / `last-updated` / `availability: deprecated`                                                                                                                                         | `hideFooterPagination` / `lastUpdatedDate` / `deprecated`                                         |
| frontmatter `slug`, `canonical-url`                                                                                                                                                                                | URLs below                                                                                        |
| frontmatter `hide-toc`, `max-toc-depth`, `hide-feedback`, `hide-page-actions`, `edit-this-page-url`, `image`, `logo`, `headline`, `nofollow`, `jsonld*`, `search-metadata`, `position`, `layout: guide`/`overview` | drop                                                                                              |

## Assets

- Copy asset folders referenced from pages and `docs.yml` (logo, favicon, fonts, icons) at their relative paths.
- OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs from `generators.yml` `api.specs`: use them in place; download remote ones.
- Fern Definition: export with `fern export [--api <name>] <file>.json`; report that it must be re-exported when the definition changes.
- Fern `overlays` are OpenAPI Overlays. Fern `overrides` are Fern's own deep-merge format; `fern api enrich` merges their `x-fern-examples` into the spec; SDK-only `x-fern-*` keys can be ignored (`mint migrate --topic api`).

Reference: https://buildwithfern.com/learn/api-definitions/overview/project-structure

## URLs and redirects

- URLs come from `docs.yml`, not file paths (https://buildwithfern.com/learn/docs/seo/configuring-slugs). Each level contributes its `slug` or its kebab-cased display name: product, version, tab, section, folder, page. `skip-slug: true` drops a level. A frontmatter `slug` replaces everything below the product/version prefix. The first version has no prefix.
- Compute each old URL with these rules and check it against `sitemap.xml`.
- Changelog entries were served at `<changelog-path>/<YYYY>/<M>/<D>` (no zero padding).
- Endpoint pages sat under the `api` entry's slug; to keep them, see `mint migrate --topic api`.
- `docs.yml` `redirects` (`source`, `destination`, `permanent`), including regex segments (`:slug(.*)`) and sources with more than one wildcard: (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).

## Known gaps

- Fern Definition content missing from the OpenAPI export; WebSocket, gRPC and OpenRPC references.
- SDK snippets from `generators.yml`, API Explorer behavior, audiences.
- Role, feature-flag and `viewers` gating; authentication.
- Tab variants, `landing-page`, custom header and footer components, global themes, Ask Fern.
- Same-day changelog entries Fern merged into one URL; changelog RSS URLs.
- Multiple `instances` (one Mintlify site per domain).
